doclingProbe.detail: docling not found on PATH (spawn failed)

reason: PDF extraction requires unpdf or Docling; neither produced usable text.
remediation: Install Docling for local OCR so `docling --version` answers on PATH (pip install docling), set DOCLING_SERVE_URL with CONSTRUCT_EXTRACTION_PRIVACY=remote-ok for shared Docling Serve, or transcribe manually.
